newsitem.title: UK: MOTOR RACING-MORBIDELLI REPLACES LARINI AT SAUBER.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-MORBIDELLI REPLACES LARINI AT SAUBER.

text.p: Italian Gianni Morbidelli will replace compatriot Nicola Larini at the Sauber Formula One team from this weekend's Spanish Grand Prix in Barcelona.
The appointment was announced on Wednesday by Ferrari, who supply customer engines to Sauber.
Morbidelli, who was Ferrari's official test driver, has not raced in Formula One since finishing third for Arrows in the 1995 Australian Grand Prix at Adelaide.

Larini, who finished sixth in the season opening Australian Grand Prix in Melbourne, will resume his duties as Ferrari's official test driver, a position he had previously held when he raced in touring cars.
